title: Finish worker compaction only on its compaction item
body:
Outcome: during thread/compact/start the driver waits for the contextCompaction item (or thread/compacted) for that thread and ignores other item/completed events, so a turn never starts before compaction has finished. Also cover a live compaction in scripts/live-worker.mjs, since compaction has not run live yet.
Source: PR #173 review attempt 6 prepass BLOCKING finding (src/worker/driver.ts:238, .krn/runs/review-series/0473f8d5.../records/6.json), accepted by lead override; krn worker is not yet used for delegation (t-qkqkwt6).
